documentation.file_docstring:
Data-layer ABAC policies for AI agent governance.

Extends the policy engine beyond tool-level to data-level enforcement.
Agents are checked not just for which tools they can use, but which
data classifications they can access.

Addresses the market gap where 63% of organizations cannot stop
their AI from accessing unauthorized data (Kiteworks 2026 research).
inline_comments: Evaluate each policy; any denial means overall denial (most restrictive wins)
member_docstrings: DataClassification: Sensitivity levels for data classification, ordered by sensitivity.
DataLabel: Label describing data sensitivity and handling requirements.
ABACPolicy: Attribute-Based Access Control policy for an agent.
DataAccessDecision: Result of evaluating an agent's data access request.

DataAccessEvaluator: Evaluates agent data-access requests against ABAC policies.

detect_pii: Detect PII patterns (SSN, email, phone) in *text*.
detect_phi: Detect PHI patterns (medical record numbers, diagnosis codes).
detect_pci: Detect PCI patterns (credit card numbers).
classify_text: Auto-classify *text* based on detected sensitive-data patterns.
